title: The former Royal Military Academy expends into the city of Resende.
text: The Military Academy of Agulhas Negras is a service academy for training of officer cadets of the Brazilian Army. It originated in 1792 with the creation of the Royal Academy of Artillery, Fortification and Drawing, the first military school of the Americas.

title: Second World War: The first five thousand Brazilian Expeditionary Force soldiers, the 6th RCT, leave Brazil for Europe aboard the USNS General Mann.
text: World War II, or the Second World War, was a global conflict between two coalitions: the Allies and the Axis powers. Nearly all of the world's countries participated, with many engaging in total war on an unprecedented scale.

title: Brazilian pilots begin operations, as individual elements of flights attached to 350th FG squadrons.
text: The Brazilian Air Force is the aerial branch of the Brazilian Armed Forces, and one of the three national uniformed services. The FAB was formed when the Brazilian Army and Navy air branches were merged into a single military force, which was initially called the "National Air Forces" when it was created in 1941.

title: The Banco Nacional is founded in São Paulo.
text: Banco Nacional was a bank from Brazil. It was taken over by Unibanco in 1995.

title: Getúlio Vargas allocated an area of 4 million square meters near Santa Maria for the purpose of building an aerodrome. Santa Maria Airport opens the following year.
text: Santa Maria Airport is the airport serving Santa Maria, Brazil. It is operated by the Municipality of Santa Maria.
wiki: Santa Maria Airport (Rio Grande do Sul)

title: Jorge Amado - São Jorge dos Ilhéus
text: Jorge Leal Amado de Faria, known as Jorge Amado, was a Brazilian writer of the modernist school. He remains the best-known of modern Brazilian writers, with his work having been translated into some 49 languages and popularized in film, including Dona Flor and Her Two Husbands in 1976, and having been nominated for the Nobel Prize in Literature at least seven times.

title: Oswald de Andrade - Meu Testamento
text: José Oswald de Souza Andrade was a Brazilian poet, novelist and cultural critic. He was born in, spent most of his life in, and died in São Paulo.

title: Camargo Guarnieri - Symphony no 1
text: Mozart Camargo Guarnieri was a Brazilian composer. Guarnieri was born in Tietê, São Paulo.
